name: docoga-owner-android
description: DocOga Owner — the Android wrapper (Capacitor) around https://docoga.com.ng/admin. It contains no secret: it is a signed, self-updating door to the authenticated dashboard. Built in CI (.github/workflows/android-apk.yml); you never need Android Studio unless you want to.

comments.icons: Icon densities are committed under android/app/src/main/res/mipmap-*/ic_launcher.png. Regenerate with: npm i --no-save pngjs && node tools/make-icons.mjs  (pngjs only — @capacitor/assets needs sharp, which downloads libvips and is therefore CI-hostile in a locked-down sandbox).
